models.name: Qwen3.8-27B on a jailbroken PS5
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B on a jailbroken PS5 (PS5LM llama.cpp port, CPU path)
models.vram_min: 6GB (about 6 GiB usable with CPU only on a jailbroken PS5)
models.system_ram_min: about 6 GiB on a jailbroken PS5, CPU only (12 GiB with the GPU)

engines.hardware: jailbroken PS5, CPU path only (about 6 GiB available without the GPU)
engines.quant: 2-bit Qwen3.8-27B weights; PS5LM, a llama.cpp port for jailbroken PS5s, about one token a minute on the CPU

models.why: The same jailbroken PS5 that runs Qwen3.8-27B at 20 tok/s on its GPU manages about one token a minute on its CPU (0.0167 tok/s) — the clearest public measure of what a 27B model costs without GPU compute.
